question: In a ΔPRQ, AB is drawn parallel to QR, cutting sides at A and B where length of PQ = 6 cm, length of QR = 8 cm and length of QA = 3 cm. What is the length of AB?
solution:
**Given:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b6f76ff19e187a010ea53633e8282709d6a9dfd5ca59b1d48635fc968cc80e3.png] **

**PA = PQ - AQ = 6 - 3 = 3cm**

**Concept used:**

In △PAB and △PQR 

∠PAB = ∠PQR (corresponding angles)

and ∠P is common.

∴ △PAB ∼ △PQR ( AA similarity criterion)

Since corresponding sides are proportional,

{ABover QR}= {PAover PQ}\:

AB={QRtimes PAover PQ}

**Calculation:**

AB=8×36" id="MathJax-Element-17-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">AB=8×36AB=8×36" id="MathJax-Element-191-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">AB=8×36AB=8×36 AB=8×36 AB={8\times 3\over 6}

AB = 4 cm

Hence, **'Option A'** is the correct answer.
